I will maintain 'Present' but note this ambiguity. artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' (Severity 2.5) and 'texture_anomaly' in cables (Severity 1.5). The Topology Auditor found high confidence masks, suggesting the knobs and screen are structurally connected and not floating, which contradicts any potential 'melting' fears. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions. The severity of the text artifact is underestimated by the Router; for a device defined by its interface, illegible text is a major functional hallucination. I will adjust the artifact score down to reflect this.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'oscilloscope' class. The Fine Grained Classifier ranked it #1 with high confidence. Key structural elements (CRT screen, graticule, BNC connectors, knob density) are visually present and correctly arranged. The only deduction is for the lack of verifiable functional labeling (text) and the cropped handle, which prevents full verification of the 'portability' feature.
